claim_limits: Elemental Li coefficients only; mapping to 6Li/7Li requires explicit shared electronic approximation or isotope-native rate data.
Ground M=1 only; metastable and finite-density population effects excluded.
CI+RR+DR network complete only for these declared processes; no claim of complete atomic microphysics.
No photoionization, external radiation Jnu, charge exchange, molecular chemistry, cooling/emissivity or recombination energy-moment provider admitted.
No coefficient values or analytic fits invented. Bare-ion DR structural zero is explicit.
scope_override: User correction before R6: only lithium and lithium ions/isotopes. Carbon source intake preserved as historical unselected; no active C provider.

isotope_evidence.status: Measured isotope shifts found; no isotope-resolved CI/RR/DR coefficient table admitted.

isotope_evidence.admission_boundary: Ionization threshold isotope shift alone does not bound RR/DR isotope changes or justify assigning elemental data as native isotope data. Shared electronic coefficients remain an explicitly named modelling approximation, not a measured equality.
isotope_evidence.authorized_model_policy: Mandatory explicit opt-in ElementalElectronicEquality for separately conserved 6Li/7Li q=0..3. Native isotope-resolved coefficient requests return MissingSource. Li8/Li9 excluded pending nuclear-decay closure.
